title.narrative: Accelerating the Market Transition for Distributed Energy Program as part of ECARES MPA

description.narrative: The development objective of the Accelerating the Market Transition for Distributed Energy Program as part of Europe and Central Asia Renewable Energy Scale-up (ECARES) Multiphase Programmatic Approach (MPA) for Türkiye is to increase renewable energy capacity in participating countries of the Europe and Central Asia region. The program development objective (PrDO) will be achieved through investments structured along three pillars: (1) enabling policies and institutional frameworks; (2) renewable energy (RE) grid integration; and (3) financial and risk mitigation solutions.

To expand the distributed solar photovoltaic market, improve the related policy environment, and promote innovation and inclusiveness, thereby contributing to a reduction in greenhouse gases (GHG) emissions.
